added_failures_note: Derived by comparing completed baseline_suite and after_suite logs: both failure sets empty, EXIT=0, summaries 58/61 passed.

assertion_analysis.fails_if: Run-name ordering, missing priority inheritance or missing fairness moves priority/B/C outside independently specified first four.
Session A request-age order reverses, loses or duplicates a request; expected fixture order is independent of the output.
Report disagrees with scheduler order; this parity assertion is backed by independent expected order at line 36.
Position numbers are missing, repeated, zero-based or discontinuous rather than 1 through 70.
Priority reason omits or misstates priority 100.
Ordinary request reason omits session sharing.
Recent ownership is ignored or expired ownership counted: independent expected B/C/A sequence changes.
Younger priority or run-name ordering wins over aged request.
Review dependency precedence is removed: aged prioritised delivery wins over its review.
Queued review explanation differs from delivered review.

assertion_independence: No vacuous input-echo assertion found; concrete sequence expectations constrain outputs independently, and line 45 is intentional surface parity backed by line 36.

findings.text: blocking: The pending list includes RUNNING and WAITING rows; RUNNING already contributes to served at lines 521-524 but receives another turn at line 559, and WAITING receives a turn despite consuming no slot; with A running, B having one recent completion, older runnable A and younger runnable B, equal actual service counts should select A first but simulating A's running row charges A twice and selects B, so exclude non-runnable rows from future-turn simulation while preserving their separate accounting.

blocking: The report forwards its rate-report window_seconds into ordering while PromotionService._tick_locked uses the fixed one-hour default; with A promoted ten minutes ago and older A/newer B waiting, --window-seconds 60 reports A before B while the drain serves B before A, so published queue positions disagree with the actual drain when this supported option is used.
